name: contextkit
description: Evidence-grounded context documents, repository graphs, and component networks for any repository.

interface.shortDescription: Explain any repository with grounded context
interface.longDescription: Writes context documents for specific readers (overview, architecture, module guide, reviewer and contributor guides, AI-agent context, interview brief), builds a validated architecture graph, and produces a component network from a deterministic scan. Every claim cites repository files or is marked inferred, and output goes outside the analyzed repository.
defaultPrompt: Write a reviewer guide for this repository
Build a REPO_GRAPH.json for this repository
Generate the component network for this repository
